```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[fermion/.style={
  postaction={decorate, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.6 with {\arrow[scale=1.5]{Stealth[]}}}}},
  photon/.style={
decorate,
decoration={snake, amplitude=3pt, segment length=8pt}}, very thick]
    \def\R{2}
    \def\r{0.1}
    \coordinate (A) at (0,0);
    \coordinate (B) at (\R,0);

    % Left fermion loop
    \draw[fermion] (A) -- ($(A)+(-135:\R)$) node[midway, above left] {$\vb{k}_1$};
    \draw[fermion] ($(A)+(135:\R)$) -- (A) node[midway, above right] {$\vb{k}_4$};

    % Right fermion loop
    \draw[fermion] (B) -- ($(B)+(-45:\R)$) node[midway, above right] {$\vb{k}_2$};
    \draw[fermion] ($(B)+(45:\R)$) -- (B) node[midway, above left] {$\vb{k}_3$};

    % Wiggly photon connecting the two loops
    \draw[photon] (B) -- (A) node[midway, above, yshift=2pt] {$\vb{k}_1-\vb{k}_4$};

    \draw[fill=white] (A) circle (\r);
    \draw[fill=white] (B) circle (\r);

\end{tikzpicture}
```
